question: Can available SCMG checkpoints start smoothly from an arbitrary stationary joint pose?
sample: 6 evenly spaced eligible validation clips; each at least 96 frames
conditions: uniform random arm joints inside META joint ranges
clipping: All initial poses are clipped 0.005 rad inside META limits; random arms are sampled 0.05 rad inside limits. Collision validity is not checked.
rng: Reset both global torch RNG and per-Streamer generator for every trial; mitigates the unseeded StyleHead found in review.
first_jump: max over arm joints of abs(command[0] - initial_pose), converted to degrees; table gives the median over trials
first_speed: abs(command[0]-initial_pose)/0.02, compared per joint against scmg/safety.py arm velocity limits
startup_limits: First 16 command frames, preceded by three copies of the initial pose; discrete velocity, acceleration and jerk compared against safety.py limits.
vae_isolation: Each of 36 unique initial poses held for 64 frames; encode posterior mean then decode; compare final reconstructed frame to the input pose.
decode_diagnostic: Reuse exactly the same generated latents, prefix four repetitions of hist0 for decoding only; never count this modified decoding as production output.
interface_check: A spy Streamer verifies generate(robot=...) first calls tick(None,None,None), despite robot having initial q/dq.
scope: Offline model evaluation only. No robot commands sent. State-adapter trained checkpoint unavailable.
